definitions.full: H2988. yabal I. [ יָבָל ] noun [masculine] watercourse, stream (properly conduit ), as irrigating; — only plural construct יִבְלֵי(ֿ)מָ֑יִם Isa 30:25 (|| מְּלָגִים ), 44:4 .
